error.password-expired: Your password has expired. Please choose a new one.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
error.not-found: The requested item was not found.
error.unable-to-connect: Unable to connect to the server.
error.password-reused: This password was already used in the last {{days}} days.

error.password-lowercase: The password must contain at least {{count}} lowercase letter(s).

setup.title: Set up {{brandName}}
setup.intro: Welcome. This page appears once, on a new server. It creates your account and your organization, then a first device.
setup.code-hint: For security, the code is shown only in the server log. To see it, run:
setup.account-intro: This account manages your devices and dashboards. You will use it every day.
setup.password-hint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
setup.sysadmin-hint: A second account, for platform settings and organizations. It gets its own random password, shown at the end; it must be changed at the first sign-in. The default address cannot receive messages: enter a real one if you want password-reset emails.
setup.device-intro: Create a sample device and a dashboard to check that everything works. You can delete them later.
setup.create-device: Create a sample device and dashboard
setup.done-intro: Your platform is set up. Send a test value, then open your dashboard.
setup.token-hint: Keep it secret: anyone with this token can send data as this device.
setup.from-device: Send data from a computer or a device
setup.open-dashboard: Sign in and open the dashboard

error.code: Wrong setup code. Check the server log. After 10 wrong tries, a new code is printed.
error.organization: Enter an organization name (255 characters at most).
error.sysadmin-email: Enter a valid email address for the platform administrator.
error.same-email: The two accounts need different email addresses.
error.password: The password must have {{min}} to 72 characters.
error.device: The device name is too long (255 characters at most).
error.already-done: This server is already set up. Sign in instead.
error.failed: Setup failed and nothing was saved. Check the server log and try again.
error.test-value: The test value was not received. Check that the server is running.

setup.sysadmin-once: Save this password now, for example in a password manager: it is shown only once. You will choose a new one at the first sign-in.

privacy.erase-text: The account, its sign-in data, preferences and notifications are deleted. Audit log entries are kept for security, with the name replaced by a pseudonym. This cannot be undone.
